info.description: Backend API for Road2D (team Vandra): collaborative multi-branch ride planning and group-ride safety in Vietnam. JWT auth, Goong Maps playground, trip graph models.
info.title: Road2D

post.description: If the email exists, send a reset-password HTML mail with a one-time link.
Authenticate with username and password. Returns access and refresh tokens.
Revoke the presented refresh token. The SHA-256 hash is stored in Redis with TTL until JWT exp, and persisted in Postgres so a Redis restart cannot revive the session.

get.description: Return the authenticated user. Password hash is never included.

post.description: Issue a new access token from a valid refresh token. Returns 401 if the refresh JWT is expired or was revoked by logout.
Create a user account. Returns the new user UUID.
Set a new password using the reset token from the forget-password mail.

get.description: Return a user by UUID. Password hash is never included.
Goong Directions v2. Default vehicle is bike (two-wheeler / motorbike lanes). motorcycle and motorbike are aliased to bike.

parameters.description: car, bike, taxi, truck, hd. motorbike/motorcycle → bike
parameters.name: vehicle

get.description: Goong Geocode v2. Provide exactly one of address (forward), latlng (reverse), or place_id. Default results use the new administrative units. has_deprecated_administrative_unit=true adds pre-merger names. has_vnid=true adds deprecated_compound_id on reverse.

parameters.description: true = also return deprecated_compound_id (VN admin codes)
parameters.name: has_vnid

get.description: Goong Place Autocomplete v2. location biases the search; origin (lat,lng) sorts by proximity and fills distance_meters. If origin is omitted, location is reused. Set has_deprecated_administrative_unit=true to also get pre-merger names.

parameters.description: Sort by distance from this lat,lng. Defaults to location
parameters.name: origin

parameters.description: Search radius in km from location. Goong default 50
parameters.name: radius

get.description: Goong Place Detail v2 by place_id. Default address is the new administrative unit.

Goong Trip v2 is a single-vehicle TSP, not a branch graph. waypoints is a bag of lat,lng points (semicolon-separated), not an edge list. The waypoints array stays in input order; waypoint_index / visit_order is the visit sequence on that one tour. trips_index is copied from OSRM and is 0 unless Goong returns several tours — it does not mean a split at a shared vertex.

parameters.description: Start lat,lng. If omitted Goong picks a stop.
parameters.name: origin

parameters.description: End lat,lng. If omitted Goong picks a stop.
parameters.name: destination

parameters.description: Stops between origin and destination, lat,lng separated by ;
parameters.name: waypoints

parameters.description: car, bike, taxi, truck, hd. Default car. motorbike/motorcycle → bike
parameters.name: vehicle

parameters.description: Turn-by-turn per leg. Default true (Goong/OSRM default is false, which yields empty steps)
parameters.name: steps

get.description: Returns groups where the caller is an active member (owner, admin, or member). Each item includes myRole. Invited/pending/left/kicked memberships are omitted.

post.description: Create a standing group. The caller becomes owner (active). Optional adminUsernames are added immediately as active admins. Unknown usernames abort the whole create. Roles: owner, admin, member. Membership statuses: invited, pending, active, rejected, left, kicked.

parameters.description: Group name, optional description, optional policy, optional admin usernames
parameters.name: body

get.description: Returns invitations waiting for the caller to accept or reject. Other users' invitations are never included.
Returns groups where the caller is an active member (owner, admin, or member). Each item includes myRole.

Returns name and description. If the caller is an active member, myRole is set (owner/admin/member). Non-members still receive public name/description so they can request to join; roster is never included here.

delete.description: Owner only. Fails with 409 if the group still has trips (trips.group_id). Members cascade-delete with the group.

patch.description: Owner or admin may change name, description, and/or policy (group rules text). Members cannot update group info. Send only the fields to change.

post.description: The invited caller accepts or rejects with ?action=accept|reject. Accept makes them an active member; reject sets status rejected.
Owner or admin invites a user by UUID. Reuses a left/rejected/kicked membership row. The invitee later accepts or rejects.
post.summary: Invite a user to a group

post.description: The caller creates a pending join request. Owner/admin later accept or reject it. Reuses a left/rejected/kicked membership row.

get.description: Owner or admin lists users waiting to join this group.

post.description: Owner or admin responds with ?action=accept|reject. Accept makes the user an active member; reject sets status rejected.
post.summary: Accept or reject a join request

post.description: The caller leaves (status left). If the owner leaves, ownership transfers to the earliest-joined admin, or the earliest-joined member if there is no admin. The last remaining owner must delete the group instead.

get.description: Returns the active roster (owner, admin, member). Invited, pending, left, rejected, and kicked rows are omitted. Any active member may call this.

delete.description: Owner may kick admin or member. Admin may kick member only. Cannot kick the owner or yourself (use leave). Target must be active. Status becomes kicked.

patch.description: An active member may change only their own nickname. Path userId must match the caller.

get.description: Returns a destination. When locationId is set, lat/lng are locked to that location.

put.description: Updates name, arrive time, stay, and status while the destination is editing. lat/lng are applied only when locationId is empty; a forked or verified pin keeps the linked location's coordinates.

post.description: Creates an editing destination from a verified location. lat/lng and the location link are copied from the location. Optional name overrides the location name.

parameters.description: Optional name, arrive time, and stay
parameters.name: body

get.description: Returns a verified location. Planning copies it with fork; this row itself is not updated here.
Returns trips where the caller is an active member (leader or member). Each item includes myRole. Left/kicked seats are omitted.

post.description: Create a planning trip under a group. The caller must be an active group member and becomes the trip leader. An invite token is minted immediately.

parameters.description: Group id, name, optional note and times
parameters.name: body

post.description: Authenticated caller joins the trip identified by the invite token as a member. Reuses a left/rejected/kicked row. Already-active members get 409.

get.description: Returns trip info. If the caller is an active member, myRole is set (leader/member). The invite token is never included.

delete.description: Leader only. Members cascade-delete with the trip.

patch.description: Leader only. Change name, note, startTime, and/or endTime. Send only the fields to change. Status is not updated here.

put.description: Replace the route graph of a planning trip. branches[0] is the main branch. Every later branch splits at its first destination and merges at its last, unless openTail marks that branch as ending without rejoining. Only a leader can edit, and only while the trip is planning.

parameters.description: Branches of destination ids and which tails stay open
parameters.name: body

post.description: Leader only. Returns the current invite token and join path. Set rotate=true to invalidate the previous link.

parameters.description: Mint a new token and drop the old one
parameters.name: rotate

post.description: The caller leaves (status left). If the leader leaves, leadership transfers to the earliest-joined remaining member. The last remaining leader must delete the trip instead.

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and JWT token.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization

PlaygroundKey.description: Shared secret from GOONG_PLAYGROUND_KEY. Scalar → Authorize.
PlaygroundKey.name: X-Playground-Key
